items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) cloud provider hit by ransomware
items.summary: ActiveCloud disclosed on Nov 11 that attackers encrypted parts of its cloud infrastructure, disrupting hosted websites, corporate email and virtual servers (reportedly including Domino's Pizza Belarus); most services were restored by Nov 13 with no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Advantage Archives Inc. listed by INC Ransom
items.summary: US professional services firm Advantage Archives appeared on the INC Ransom leak site with an attack date of Nov 13, 2026.

items.title: Ransomware attacks up 23 percent
items.summary: Industry reporting shows ransomware attack volume rising 23 percent, setting the backdrop for Q4 2026 activity.

items.title: State of Ransomware 2026 tracker
items.summary: BlackFog's running 2026 tracker of publicly disclosed ransomware attacks, last updated Nov 5, 2026.

ransomware.note: Named-victim reporting for late November was thin today; SOCRadar also lists unnamed victims claimed by n0n (Nov 9) and Everest (Nov 13).

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage
items.summary: Microsoft 365 suffered a major outage during the Nov 12-17 cluster of tech disruptions.

items.title: Workday outage
items.summary: Workday's SaaS platform had a major outage in the same Nov 12-17 window.

items.title: FAA air traffic network ground stop
items.summary: An FAA air traffic network failure triggered a ground stop during the Nov 12-17 period; United Airlines also logged a major outage that week.

items.title: Apple iCloud disruption
items.summary: Apple iCloud services were disrupted by an internal update during the Nov 12-17 window.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase outage
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase customer services had a major outage in the same mid-November cluster.

outage.note: No confirmed AWS, Azure or Google Cloud infrastructure outage found for November 2026; items are from aggregator timelines, not official post-incident reports.

items.title: CISA adds six KEVs incl. Chrome zero-day and Barracuda ESG RCE
items.summary: On Nov 10 CISA added six actively exploited flaws spanning Microsoft Outlook, Google Chrome, Barracuda appliances, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Webtop.

items.title: CISA adds four KEVs with 3-day deadline (GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, Aspera Faspex)
items.summary: Added Nov 9 with a Nov 12 remediation and forensic-triage deadline; GPUStack exploitation involved malicious backend creation.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws added to KEV
items.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities were added to the KEV catalog with a Nov 13, 2026 federal deadline.

items.title: Critical Node2Shell flaw under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA warned that hackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell vulnerability.

items.title: Puppet Enterprise deserialization RCE listed
items.summary: CISA listed a Perforce Puppet Enterprise deserialization flaw (CVSS 9.4) that can allow remote code execution.

items.title: N-able MailAssure flaw exploited; MONAI Label zero-day
items.summary: Reporting on Nov 24 says attackers are exploiting an N-able MailAssure flaw, while AI agents were used to exploit a MONAI Label zero-day.

items.title: Catastrophic flooding in Brevard County, Florida
items.summary: Up to 612 mm (24.1 in) of rain fell near Malabar Nov 1-2, prompting a Florida emergency declaration.

items.title: Two typhoons strike the Philippines in one week
items.summary: Two major typhoons hit the Philippines in early November, flooding homes in Cebu and forcing mass evacuations.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast of India on Nov 3.

items.title: Ecuador and southern Brazil flooding
items.summary: Ecuador floods killed 12 and affected ~56,000 people; Santa Catarina, Brazil logged 671 storm incidents across 76 municipalities Nov 4-5.

items.title: M 6.8 - 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor Leste
items.summary: Nov 21; no tsunami, USGS PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.7 - 7 km ENE of Carhuamayo, Peru
items.summary: Nov 21; tsunami flag set, PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.5 - Vanuatu region
items.summary: Nov 23; tsunami flag set, PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 6.4 - Mauritius-Reunion region
items.summary: Nov 24; no tsunami, PAGER alert green.

items.title: M 5.9 - 238 km SW of Yanglong, China
items.summary: Nov 21; no tsunami, PAGER alert yellow.

physical.note: No major wildfire events found for November 2026.
